title: The 'entangled bank' laws produce the diversity of living forms

fields.label: Label
fields.value: The 'entangled bank' laws produce the diversity of living forms

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The varied and interdependent forms of life were produced by laws still acting: growth with reproduction; inheritance; variability caused by external conditions and by use and disuse; a rate of increase high enough to cause a struggle for life and so natural selection, which in turn causes divergence of character and extinction of less improved forms.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural Selection, or the Preservation of Favoured Races in the Struggle for Life

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: These laws, taken in the largest sense, being Growth with Reproduction; Inheritance which is almost implied by reproduction; Variability from the indirect and direct action of the external conditions of life, and from use and disuse; a Ratio of Increase so high as to lead to a Struggle for Life, and as a consequence to Natural Selection, entailing Divergence of Character and the Extinction of less-improved forms.

fields.label: Agent
fields.value: delphisci Origin of Species claim extractor

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Charles Darwin, On the Origin of Species (1st ed., London: John Murray, 1859), Chapter XIV, “Recapitulation and Conclusion”; section “Concluding remarks”. Scope: all organic beings

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on darwin1859-ch14-14: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.69

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Every component has measurable consequences and substantial public data, but the full causal synthesis cannot be cleanly identified from one integrated record. Existing analyses can resolve subsets and compare restricted process models.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Fit integrated evolutionary models linking reproduction, inheritance, environmental and use-related variation, population growth, competition, selection, trait divergence and extinction to observed phylogenomic and fossil patterns. Compare predictive performance with models omitting each proposed process.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Several listed mechanisms produce overlapping macroevolutionary signatures.

Inherited effects of use and disuse require historical reinterpretation.

No single dataset jointly observes all processes over evolutionary time.

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Some listed processes have ordinary dataset tests, and public sequences, occurrences and fossils speak to inheritance, distribution and extinction separately. The claim asserts that the whole list, taken together, produced living diversity, which is a program of research rather than one analysis. Discriminating power stays low because many different biological theories are compatible with the same broad list.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Treat the listed laws as separate variables, heritability, environmentally associated variation, population increase, differential persistence, divergence and extinction, and ask which of them can be shown jointly in existing datasets. The package is only partly testable: heritability, rapid potential increase and extinction have dataset criteria, while inheritance of use and disuse and the claim that this list jointly produces all living diversity do not have one decision rule.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The sentence binds several mechanisms, including variability from use and disuse, into one cause of all diversity, and those pieces do not share a single confirming result.

Showing heritability or extinction in existing data leaves the joint production of the entangled bank untested.

A small team cannot compile a decisive analysis of every named law from current databases in weeks.
